about.summary: Final-year Software Engineering student (graduating Dec 2026) who builds backend systems with .NET and NestJS. Spent 4 months on a Rikkeisoft team shipping caching and user-management features, and built most of AnSite, a camera-based factory safety platform that started as my capstone.
feat.ansite.title: AnSite: Camera-Based Safety Platform for Factories
feat.ansite.meta: Lead Developer | Capstone Project & Startup | NestJS, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, Socket.IO, Docker, Python
feat.ansite.b1: Split the system by workload: a Python edge agent on the factory LAN handles camera streams and YOLO/VLM detection, while a NestJS cloud API owns the database, so heavy AI load cannot take down the dashboard.
feat.ansite.b2: Diagnosed a concurrency bug where a lock held during slow work (image processing, uploads) blocked config updates for 71 s; narrowing the lock cut the delay to under 0.4 s, with a regression test.
feat.ansite.b3: Built the NestJS alert ingestion API with idempotent writes (retries with the same event ID never duplicate an alert), composite PostgreSQL indexes for per-organization queries, and real-time push via Socket.IO rooms.
feat.ansite.b4: Secured edge devices with per-device activation and SHA-256-hashed credentials compared in constant time.
feat.ansite.b5: Deployed to a Linux VPS with GitHub Actions CI and 2,800+ automated tests across API, web and edge; changes follow a written plan with acceptance checks before AI agents implement them, then a separate review.
feat.eh.title: EventHub: Event Booking Platform
feat.eh.meta: Backend Developer | Personal Project | ASP.NET Core 8, EF Core, SQL Server, Ocelot, SignalR, Docker
feat.eh.b1: Decomposed event booking into 10 ASP.NET Core services, each with its own SQL Server database, behind an Ocelot gateway that routes authenticated REST and SignalR traffic.
feat.eh.b2: Kept bookings consistent without a shared database: the booking flow validates tickets and vouchers, takes VNPay/MoMo payment, and on failure calls compensating actions that restore tickets and vouchers.
feat.cs.title: Calendar Shop: Mobile E-Commerce App
feat.cs.meta: Backend Developer | Team of 5 | ASP.NET Core 8, EF Core, SQL Server, OData, JWT, VNPay, Flutter
feat.cs.b1: Hardened the VNPay payment flow by verifying the callback signature, amount and current order state before marking an order paid, with a background worker that cancels orders left unpaid after 15 minutes.
feat.cs.b2: Designed one query endpoint per resource that lets the mobile app filter, page and pick fields itself, so new screens needed no new endpoints; queries compile to SQL that selects only the requested columns (OData, EF Core projection).
feat.cs.b3: Implemented refresh-token rotation with revocation on logout, password reset and account lock, used by the Flutter app for silent re-login.
exp.meta: Rikkeisoft | Ho Chi Minh City | VMS (Visitor & Manpower Management System)
exp.b1: Prevented cache stampedes in a shared Redis caching module for 4 NestJS services: a token-checked distributed lock lets only one request rebuild an expired entry while the rest back off with jitter.
exp.b2: Kept cached data correct after writes with version-based invalidation (one Redis counter per entity, hashed query keys); traced and fixed a bug where one write bumped versions several times and emptied the cache too often.
exp.b3: Built User Management end-to-end (NestJS API, DTOs, React admin page, unit tests).
